profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bose Corporation
profile.summary: Experienced Software Control Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the automotive industry. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Science - MS focused in Engineering Management from Oakland University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Managed cross-functional teams to develop end-to-end platform and integration of advanced audio algorithms into Qualcomm Snapdragon SoC within project timelines and budget
- Devised innovative solutions for integrating complex algorithms into external SoCs, collaborating with cross-disciplinary teams to design scalable, efficient architectures, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance across hardware and software platforms
- Successfully brought up Qualcomm Snapdragon board, configuring and running multiple frameworks (e.g., Audioreach, Audio Micro Service, io-sound) with seamless audio pass-through, optimizing hardware-software integration, and ensuring high-quality audio performance across diverse applications
- Developed computing platforms and software tools/frameworks that enabled Bose to deliver an outstanding acoustic experience inside the cabin of Bose-equipped vehicles
- Cultivated custom Simulink/Matlab modules that allow our state-of-the-art signal processing algorithms to run in selected embedded software environment
- Collaborated with adjacent functional groups (e.g. Applied Research, Embedded Software, Systems Engineering) and played a critical role in creating the next generation computing platforms that bring to life our latest audio experiences

positions.title: Powertrain Software and Controls Engineer
positions.description:
- Reviewed and analyzed high-level vehicle functional requirements, including engineering design change requests, and translated them into controls algorithmic solutions using Matlab – Simulink and programmed the solutions using embedded C/C++ for GPEC microcontrollers
- Participated in ISO 26262 item definition reviews of new functions and identifying safety-relevant functions
- Identified the Automotive Safety Integrity Level (ASIL), planning a safety case, preparing ISO 26262 documentation such as, but not limited to, safety concept block diagrams, preliminary hazard analyses, and translating the safety concept block diagram into a technical safety concept
- Documented, designed, tested, and validated safety control systems
- Developed integrated powertrain control algorithms for Torque characterization, engine/transmission interactions, powertrain optimization strategies, cruise control, engine start/stop, torque path, CAN bus message transmitting/receiving, and engine torque estimation
- Analyzed system safety, drive-by-wire monitoring, and torque security
- Utilized sensors in feedback and feedforward to develop control algorithms
- Participated in DFEMAs, common cause analyses, and fault tree analyses to root cause and identify and resolve issues in the control strategies
- Developed algorithms to conform to high-level/functional requirements within program timelines, using Matlab-Simulink and rapid prototyping tools in the vehicle, dynamometer, and simulator environment
- Developed algorithms and followed the development through to production software, including the development of all supporting documentation and calibration goals
- Validated new control strategies and algorithms in testing environments such as Hardware In-Loop, Software in the loop, and Vehicles

positions.title: Nuclear Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performed focused surveillance such as performance monitoring, specifying inspections and maintenance strategies for different plant equipment.  
•	Conducted detailed root cause investigations and produced assessments of plant equipment to trend and resolve issues by providing path forward.
•	Implemented different tools using SQL to mine data to generate reports and collect critical plant related information with an overall impact of improving efficiencies around the office. 
•	Drafted quality engineering reports and prepared standardized work procedures based on design requirements to conduct repairs and quality inspections.
•	Conducted regular quality audits, developed project execution plans and worked with engineering teams to establish measures to mitigate failures of equipment.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Instructed and delivered short lesson on Engineering Math principles and Matlab to students.
•	Answered questions and explained concepts to students in small groups and individually.
•	Graded lab assignments and tests based on the solution guide from the instructor and provided helpful feedback to students.

•	Researched and recommended prudent textbooks and learning materials.

projects.title: Autonomous Mobile Robot
projects.description:
- Simulated the Khepera III robot in Python and Matlab using the sim.I.am simulator.
- Programmed different behaviors and controllers for the robot by using the infra-red (IR) sensors and wheel encoders.
- Procured all parts from various vendors to reduce costs and assembled the QuickBot mobile robot.
- Performed the simulated controllers on the QuickBot using the BeagleBone Black microcontroller.

projects.title: Microcontroller Programming
projects.description:
- Programmed STM ARM Cortex microcontroller in C for many applications using Keil µVision cross compiler.
- Applied concepts such as Signal Acquisition, Timers, Interrupts, Data IO, A/D Conversion with DMA’s, Pulse Width Modulation, I2C protocol with EEPROM and Flash.
- Created many useful applications such as Temperature Control, using temperature sensors and actuators.
